image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a textured, light-colored rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with a distinct dorsal shell composed of eight overlapping plates surrounded by a thick, leathery girdle. There is visible pinkish text/watermark in the bottom right corner.
